title: SK Hynix says it plans to spend ~$1.05B over five years to support domestic suppliers of chip materials, parts, and equipment, strengthening its supply chain (Heekyong Yang/Reuters)
summary: Heekyong Yang / Reuters: SK Hynix says it plans to spend ~$1.05B over five years to support domestic suppliers of chip materials, parts, and equipment, strengthening its supply chain — South Korea's SK Hynix (000660.KS) said on Monday it plans to spend 1.4 trillion won ($1.05 billion) over the next five years …
